data.case_title: Conditional offer for MSc Embedded Systems – Beispielwetzlar Graduate School of Engineering
data.explanation: The graduate school has made you a conditional offer for the MSc Embedded Systems programme starting in April 2027. The offer only becomes final once your bachelor's degree is verified. You need to upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal by the deadline shown. If these documents are not received in time, the offer will lapse, so it is worth uploading them well before the deadline and keeping a confirmation of the upload.
